channel.title: Animation Gems
channel.description: Animation watch — open source software, Blender animation add-ons, rigging, mocap and video capture, 2D animation (Grease Pencil, OpenToonz, Krita…).

item.title: Dynamic Skinning 0.1.1 (cartoon effects on a Blender rig)
item.description: Released Oct 25–26: the Blender extension of the IEEE TVCG 2026 paper adds real-time lag, oscillation and propagation to a skinned character, driven by its bones' velocity. Prototype, Blender 4.4+, GPL (C++ code under MIT).

item.title: anymove (mocap for any creature from an AI video)
item.description: Published Oct 27 under Apache-2.0: an AI video shows the creature front and side in one frame, a DINOv2 reader finds every joint and the rig (wings, tails, eight legs) is fitted frame by frame, then exported as GLB. Needs an NVIDIA GPU and the paid fal API.

item.title: mmdance 0.1.0 (MMD dances on a Mixamo character in Blender)
item.description: Released Oct 26 under MIT: a headless Python pipeline for Blender 5.2 that retargets a MikuMikuDance VMD onto a Mixamo, Tripo, Meshy or AccuRig character, with camera, face (blinks, lip-sync) and skirt and hair physics, then renders the video.

item.title: LipScan 0.5.0 (voice → lip-sync and face curves)
item.description: Version 0.5.0 on Oct 26 (MIT, runs locally): tracks a real face on video (52 blendshapes, head, gaze) to replay it on a rig, or turns a voice alone into mouth, blink and brow curves, exported as ARKit 52 for Blender, Unity, Unreal.

item.title: OrthoRig 0.2.0 (2D rigs from Blender to PixiJS)
item.description: Version 0.2.0 on Oct 25 (MIT): build an orthographic 2D skeleton in Blender and it compiles it for PixiJS v8 with 2-bone IK, look-at, sockets, timeline events from markers, additive layers and a spritesheet baker.

item.title: spine-mcp 0.2.0 (Spine driven by an AI)
item.description: First release Oct 25 (MIT): an MCP server that lets your AI assistant build and animate Spine 4.x skeletons without the editor (bones, slots, skins, IK and physics constraints, keys), with output checked against the official runtime. Spine itself is paid.

item.title: MetaHuman ARKit Export (ARKit blendshapes from DNA)
item.description: Published Oct 24, MIT since Oct 26: an Unreal 5.7 plugin and a standalone CLI that bake the 52 ARKit blendshapes onto an exported MetaHuman, as glTF from UE or straight into the .dna files, which UE doesn't do on its own.

item.title: OSATURA 0.1.0-alpha.4 (2D vector rigging and animation in Rust)
item.description: Pre-release from Oct 25 (CLI AGPL-3.0, libraries MPL-2.0): a Moho-style 2D engine with bones, IK, skinning, deformers, a state machine, a browser studio, and GIF, video, Lottie, glTF or HTML player export. Still alpha, code largely AI-written.

item.title: CTRL_DEF 0.1.2 (auto controllers from DEF bones)
item.description: Released Oct 24 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.2 to 5.2): select your DEF_ bones and the add-on generates colored FK controllers with shared custom shapes in one click, then binds them without dependency cycles. Same author as Auto Copy Transforms DEF (seen Oct 23).

item.title: FaceSet Creature Rigger 1.0.0
item.description: Released Oct 24 (MIT, Blender 4.2+): paint each creature limb as a Face Set, the add-on detects symmetry, lets you pick FK, IK with pole, Spline IK or wiggle, then generates the armature and smoothed weights. Brand new, 0 stars.

item.title: FellowStudio3D 0.1.0 (pixel character posing and animation)
item.description: First release Oct 24 (MIT, Windows): start from a walk or run, tweak each body part, stack motion layers, IK and physical follow, without editing keys, then export 64×64 sprites at 1x, 4x or 8x.

item.title: Auto Dangle Rig 1.9.0 (bone chains for skirts, hair, ribbons)
item.description: Paid Blender 5.2 add-on (¥300, BOOTH): builds dangle bone chains from a selection, one per skirt column, mirrors ribbons, weights by transfer or distance, then previews the jiggle on a Mixamo/VRMA clip. Announced Oct 22.

item.title: mmd-retarget 0.0.2 (VMD from one model to another, without clipping)
item.description: Created Oct 23 (GPL-3.0, Python, VMD ↔ Blender): retargets an MMD dance to another body with scaling, foot locking and arm IK, then detects frame-by-frame interpenetration with CSV/JSON reports. Very early, docs in Chinese.

item.title: C3D Reader 0.3.4 (local Mokka-style C3D viewer)
item.description: Released Oct 23 (MIT): opens your C3D mocap files locally (Apple Silicon macOS app or browser), 3D marker playback, synced analog signals, events, parameter inspector and batch CSV export, even on takes of several hundred MB.

item.title: Prima Motion Capture Volume Planner (mocap camera placement)
item.description: Published Oct 24 (AGPL-3.0 plus extra terms, name and logo not licensed): single-file web app to plan optical mocap camera placement (OptiTrack, Qualisys, Vicon), coverage, marker visibility and predicted 3D error. Geometric model only.

item.title: Batlejka (multi-camera sync → FreeMoCap → .blend)
item.description: Released Oct 21 (AGPL-3.0): drop the clips of a multi-camera mocap session (phones, no timecode), it syncs them by audio, lets you cut takes, then runs FreeMoCap to get 3D skeletons all the way to a .blend file.

item.title: three-procedural-locomotion
item.description: Released Oct 22 (MIT): procedural human locomotion for Three.js with no baked clips. Walk, run, turns, crouch and jump computed every frame (footstep planning, two-bone IK, feet on terrain), tuned against CMU mocap.

item.title: Pixel Puppettier (layer-based rigging for Aseprite)
item.description: Released Oct 22 (MIT): Aseprite extension that attaches bones to layers, with hierarchy and mouse posing; “Create frame” builds a new frame where each part stays on its own layer for pixel-art cleanup. UI in Spanish.

item.title: Auto Copy Transforms DEF 1.1.5
item.description: Released Oct 22 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.2+ and 5.x): batch-creates Copy Transforms/Rotation/Location/Scale constraints between DEF and MCH/ORG bones, prefix, regex and L/R mapping, preview before applying and cleanup that leaves manual constraints alone.

item.title: prompt2rig (prompt → Mixamo character animation, fingers included)
item.description: Type a motion, a video model acts it out, then GVHMR + WiLoR (added Oct 20) extract body and fingers for a Mixamo character, .glb export to Blender or Unity. Apache-2.0 code, but GVHMR, SMPL-X and WiLoR are non-commercial and video goes through fal (paid).

item.title: KinetiFrame (2D animation studio for Android)
item.description: Released Oct 21: Apache-2.0 Android app mixing frame-by-frame drawing (onion skin, layers) with IK-rigged characters, finger-recorded performances, camera moves, audio and MP4 export. Offline, no account; still in development, no stable release yet.

item.title: kr-custom-rigs (Rigify extensions: configurable eye, rig tools)
item.description: GPL-3.0 Rigify extensions, Blender 5.2 compatible since Oct 21: a configurable eye rig (iris, groups, eyelids optional), a rig that moves drivers onto DEF bones, and a weight-paint mode that frees the generated rig’s bones.

item.title: Mocap Studio (video → Mixamo animation, local)
item.description: Released Oct 22: local web app (MIT) on top of Motion2MixamoRig. Upload a video of one person and a Mixamo character, it replays the motion, .glb export and an Unreal-mannequin style skeleton. Non-commercial use only (GVHMR, SMPL-X); UI in Vietnamese.

item.title: Live2D Offline Converter 0.3.0 (Live2D → Blender bones)
item.description: Experimental Blender add-on (MIT, v0.3.0 on Oct 19) that samples a Live2D clip and converts it into a native Blender armature, weights and Action that play without the plugin. 0.3 bakes masks and blend modes (Cycles). You supply the Cubism SDK yourself.

item.title: QuadMocap (AI video mocap for any rig)
item.description: Local web app (MIT, published Oct 20): give it a rigged character, it trains a DINOv2 detector on renders of your rig, then fits the skeleton to a two-view AI video. Outputs a Blender Action, .blend and FBX; tested on quadrupeds.

item.title: Stylized 2D Mouth Rig (2D mouth for Blender)
item.description: Blender 5.2 add-on launched Oct 20 at $5: one click puts a stylized 2D mouth on any head, driven in Pose Mode from a floating panel, with 28 expression and lip-sync presets, 4 styles, customizable teeth and tongue.

item.title: cascadeur MMD toolkit 1.0 (VMD in Cascadeur)
item.description: Free Cascadeur plugin (v1.0 on Oct 19, Windows): import MMD .vmd motions onto your characters, export VMD as FK or IK and clean up the generated rig. Heads-up: no license, binary only, the repo holds just the docs.

item.title: Ekza Animator (glTF/VRM character animation in the browser)
item.description: Open-source (MIT, alpha) in-browser character animator launched Oct 18: circle controls and leg IK on a GLB or VRM, Dope Sheet, a Graph Editor with Maya-style tangents, then bake back into the original file or export VRMA.

item.title: MotionBridge 0.3.0 (browser video mocap → Blender and 2D)
item.description: First public release (MIT, Oct 19): the video is analysed in the browser (MediaPipe), the motion is retargeted onto your GLB/FBX character and exported as animated GLB or BVH for Blender; a second workspace animates 2D PNG cutout puppets.

item.title: Lightweight CPU VTuber Tracker 0.1.0 (GPU-free webcam VRM mocap)
item.description: Native Windows webcam tracker in Rust (v0.1.0, Oct 19) that drives a VRM avatar on the CPU alone: 52 ARKit blendshapes, gaze, arms, torso and fingers at 30 fps. Code is Apache-2.0/MIT, but the bundled body model is under the SAM License: read it before pro use.

item.title: Riggle 0.1.1 (rig + jiggle bones, Blender-powered)
item.description: Local rigging workbench (MIT, heavy WIP) driven by Blender: fit a 22-joint humanoid skeleton to your mesh, mark what should wobble (jiggle bones), then export rigged GLB + FBX with a spring manifest. Portable Windows build on Oct 19.

item.title: PuppetForge 1.0 (2D puppets on Android)
item.description: 2D puppet studio for Android (MIT, v1.0 on Oct 20), a free alternative to Character Animator: PNG layers, pivots and bone hierarchy set by touch, live-performed animation, mic-driven lip sync, GIF or MP4 export, all on-device.

item.title: Rigger 1.2.0 (Blender auto-rig + video to animation)
item.description: Modular auto-rigger for Blender 4.2+ (GPL-3.0): 1.2.0 (Oct 18) adds local video-to-animation (body, fingers, ARKit shape keys, root motion, planted feet), AI-placed markers and a picker right in the 3D viewport.

item.title: XR Animator 0.36.0 (AI webcam mocap)
item.description: Full-body webcam mocap (MediaPipe) for VRM/MMD avatars, web or desktop: 0.36.0 (Oct 17) adds a faster “lite” body model, a GPU/CPU choice and local web app mode on Android and iOS. Free, but the repo declares no license.

item.title: L2DEditor (Live2D-style 2D puppet rigging)
item.description: Open-source (Apache-2.0) 2D puppet editor, a Cubism alternative published Oct 19: PSD import, meshing and auto-rig, keyforms, physics, .moc3 export without Live2D binaries, plus a CLI and an MCP server so AI agents can drive it.

item.title: MotionForge 1.0.1 (2D animation studio for Windows)
item.description: Flash-style vector 2D animation studio (MIT, C#/.NET 10, Windows) released Oct 19: keyframe timeline with eased tweens, layers, symbols, onion skin, GIF, PNG, sprite sheet and SVG export. 1.0.1 smooths the brush and adds an HSV wheel.

item.title: VisemeMaker 1.0.0 (VRChat visemes from A-I-U-E-O)
item.description: Unity tool (MIT) released Oct 16 that builds VRChat’s 14 visemes from the 5 vowel shapes most models already have (MMD, VRoid, Source…) and wires lip sync on the avatar descriptor, with preview and strength control.

item.title: CEB SAM 3D Body Loader (AI mocap in Blender, now free)
item.description: Since Oct 17, Carlos Barreto’s add-on is free: video mocap (GEM-X, SAM 3D Body) in Blender 4.0 to 5.2, retargeting to Auto-Rig Pro, foot-sliding fix, walk along a curve. Windows only; some underlying models are restricted to non-commercial use.

item.title: Viewport Avatar Toolset 0.4.1 (Bento animation for Second Life)
item.description: Free, open-source animation editor (LGPL-2.1, Linux and Windows) for Second Life’s Bento avatar: timeline, IK, graph editor, BVH, glTF, FBX or network mocap import, .anim and BVH export. Version 0.4 (Oct 17) resizes the whole skeleton and scales the keys.

item.title: video2live2d (video → Live2D motion)
item.description: Command-line tool (MIT, Linux and macOS) released Oct 17 that turns a face-and-shoulders video into a Live2D Cubism motion3.json for VBridger models: head, eyes, brows, mouth, breathing, auto calibration. No iPhone, no live tracking.

item.title: PaperDoll 1.0.0 (Inochi2D puppets in C#)
item.description: .NET runtime (BSD-2), 1.0.0 out Oct 17, that loads, animates and draws Inochi2D 2D puppets (.inp, .inx) in FNA or MonoGame: parameters, mesh deformation, masks, physics, several puppets on screen. A from-scratch C# port of Inochi2D and nijilive.

item.title: Stop Motion Pancake (stop-motion studio)
item.description: Desktop stop-motion studio (MIT, macOS, Windows, Linux) online since Oct 15: webcam or iPhone capture, onion skinning, vector rotoscoping, exposures on 1s, 2s or 3s, frame-by-frame audio scrubbing for lip-sync and an exposure sheet.

item.title: CAST (video mocap for any skeleton)
item.description: MIT code + CAST Live Blender add-on released Oct 16: captures motion from an RGB video and transfers it in real time to skeletons with a different topology (crab, quadruped…). MIT weights; DINOv3 backbone (Meta licence) and SAM2 to be supplied separately, CUDA GPU required.

item.title: ComfyUI-GEM-X (NVIDIA GEM-X video mocap → FBX)
item.description: ComfyUI nodes (Apache-2.0, Oct 15): full-body mocap (77 joints, hands and face) from a single video with NVIDIA GEM-X, then retarget onto Mixamo, Unreal or Unity FBX with a built-in 3D preview. Weights under the NVIDIA Open Model License, ~10 GB of models, NVIDIA GPU required.

item.title: anny-maya 1.2.1 (Anny parametric human in Maya)
item.description: Maya 2022–2027 module (Apache-2.0, v1.2.1 of Oct 16) bringing NAVER’s Anny human model (CC0 data): age and body shape sliders, 52 ARKit shapes, optional Google GNM head, then bake to a classic Maya rig (joints, skinCluster, blendShapes) ready for animation and FBX.

item.title: RigFlow (animation transfer for Maya)
item.description: Maya tool (MIT, online Oct 16) that transfers body animation between characters with different proportions and naming: automatic joint matching with a confidence score, manual tweaks, HumanIK preview before baking, face untouched. Alpha, Maya 2023–2024, no release.

item.title: ToothPaste for Blender 1.1.6 (SVG → Grease Pencil)
item.description: Blender 5.0+ extension (online Oct 15) that pastes or imports SVG from Illustrator, Figma, Affinity or Inkscape as Grease Pencil v3: editable materials, multi-level masks, layer splitting, partial gradients. CC-BY-4.0 licence, unusual for code.

item.title: Moho 14.5 SHOWTIME
item.description: Paid 2D animation software: 14.5 (Oct 12, free for Moho 14 owners) adds a Live Playback mode that drives your characters with a webcam (face) or a gamepad via Smart Bones/Actions, recordable as keyframes. Plus a reworked Paint Bucket and magnetic onion skins.

item.title: ParaRig 1.2.0
item.description: Free Blender add-on (GPL-3.0) that generates a panel of sliders to drag in the viewport and wires the drivers to shape keys, bones or properties by itself, with no expressions to write. 1.2.0 (Oct 14) drives X/Y/Z of the same bone from a single slider.

item.title: rig-c (compiled 2D rigging, Spine output)
item.description: 2D rig compiler (MIT) designed for AI agents: part PNGs + JSON spec → Spine 4.3 skeleton (paid editor), checked by assertions before writing. The pose module (v0.22.1, Oct 16) transfers a pose taken from a video onto the rig. v0.x prototype.

item.title: aimocap 0.5.0 (video → MetaHuman mocap, UE 5.8)
item.description: UE 5.8 plugin + CLI (MIT, Oct 15): video → two-person mocap via GVHMR (non-commercial licence), foot sliding cleanup, MetaHuman retarget, auto sequence and QC report. Seedance video generation paid in credits; tested only on Win 11/RTX 3090, docs in Chinese.

item.title: @three-ws/retarget
item.description: Three.js library (Apache-2.0, published Oct 10) that renames the bones of any GLB humanoid (Mixamo, VRM, Daz, UE, HumanIK, Blender .L/.R…) to a canonical skeleton and retargets your clips onto it with rest pose correction, plus a blending runtime.

item.title: Rigby2D
item.description: Free 2D skeletal animation editor (MIT), born Oct 13: PSD/PNG import, bones drawn in the viewport, dopesheet + graph editor, IK, JSON/.skel + atlas export compatible with common runtime formats. Tauri app for Win/Mac/Linux, to be compiled (no binary yet).

item.title: Character DNA Addon 0.14.4 (MetaHuman → Blender)
item.description: GPL-3.0 Blender add-on (free base, paid Pro version) that imports MetaHuman DNA files with face board and correctives via OpenRigLogic, then sends them back to Unreal. 0.14.x (Oct 9–14) switches RigLogic to Z-up and fixes eyes/mouth. Blender 4.5/5.2.

item.title: Kinesia
item.description: Multi-person 3D mocap from a single video (CC0 code): SAM 3.1 + SAM 3D Body + DINOv3, tracking and re-identification, feet anchored to the ground, web viewer. Heavy (Linux, ~32 GB NVIDIA GPU), Meta models under a restrictive SAM licence, CSV/JSON export (no BVH/FBX announced).

item.title: Driver Espresso Lite 1.6.6
item.description: Free Blender add-on (GPL-3.0): 18 ready-to-use driver “recipes” (oscillation, blinking, looping rotation, fades, ease/spring, RGB neons) with a live curve preview and offset across several objects or bones. Native drivers: the animation survives uninstalling.

item.title: KeyCraft MIDI 1.4.0
item.description: Free Blender add-on (GPL-3.0) that generates a piano/synth keyboard and animates it from a MIDI controller, recorded as editable keyframes. 1.4.0 (Oct 14) handles existing keyboards, multi-channel, organ and MIDI/MusicXML/PDF playback. Live MIDI on Windows only.

item.title: mGear 5.4.0
item.description: Free Maya rigging framework (MIT): 5.4 (Oct 14) adds Facial Rigger 3.0 (unified eyes/lips/brows), Anim Picker 2.0 (SVG, widgets), Blocking Ghosts (3D onion skinning), Spring Manager 2.0 and ~2× faster Shifter builds. Maya 2022–2027.

item.title: Instant Rigger and Animator
item.description: Paid Blender add-on ($39, GPL) released Oct 1: guided humanoid auto-rig (clothing, separate parts, robots), a library of 2,300+ clips, IK corrections and FBX/GLB export without leaving Blender. Blender 3.3–5.2.

item.title: Grease Pencil Auto Interpolate
item.description: Paid Blender add-on ($15, MIT licence) updated Oct 2: automatically interpolates Grease Pencil in-betweens via Geometry Nodes, in real time and non-destructively, plus line-art import and a Link Strokes mode. Blender 4.3–5.2.

item.title: SAM3DBody-cpp
item.description: Python-free C++ engine for SAM 3D Body: real-time 3D mocap from a single camera, multi-person, per-actor BVH export ready for Blender (script provided). MIT code; weights from Meta’s SAM 3D Body model, check its licence before commercial use.

item.title: PhoneRig for Blender 1.1.0
item.description: New (Oct 11), free and GPL-3.0: an Android phone becomes a 6DoF virtual camera for Blender via ARCore, with video feedback, take recording as keyframes, baking to clean F-curves and presets (shoulder, dolly, crane). Local Wi-Fi, Blender 4.2+.

item.title: MeshRig 0.2.0
item.description: New free standalone app (GPL-3.0, Windows/macOS/Linux) that rigs a mesh from a .blend: humanoid, quadruped or chain skeleton fitted inside the volume, weights computed through the volume, weight brush, auto IK and pose test. Drives Blender (tested on 5.2) in the background.

item.title: Ayatsuri2D 0.5.3
item.description: Open alternative to Live2D Cubism (GPL-3.0, Rust) for real-time 2D puppetry: moc3 v3 to v6 import and export (VTube Studio compatible), open .aom format, runtime embeddable via a C API. Very young: pre-releases, editor still under construction.

item.title: Iki (web 2D puppet engine)
item.description: MIT 2D puppet engine for the web, an alternative to Live2D and Inochi2D: open .iki JSON format, warp mesh, masks, hair physics, editor and auto-rig from PNG/PSD layers, plus an MCP server to have an AI generate the parts. Online demo.

item.title: Auto Face Mocap Pro
item.description: New paid Blender add-on (from $99 personal, $129 commercial, GPL) released October 11: it applies facial capture from a simple webcam or phone video to a character with ARKit shape keys. Blender 5.2. Launch offer −30%.

item.title: Rig-GNS Pro 4.6.0
item.description: Paid Blender add-on (from $80) for Rigify rigging and retargeting (Mixamo, Rokoko, ActorCore…) for Daz Genesis figures and custom humanoids. 4.6.0 (Oct 11) adds movable landmark markers with symmetry and an editable joint preview before generation.

item.title: VRM Add-on for Blender 4.10.2
item.description: Import/export and editing of VRM avatars in Blender (GPL-3.0 / MIT). 4.10.0 (Oct 10) adds experimental support for spring bone limits; 4.10.1 and 4.10.2 fix expressions/blend shapes detached on VRM0/VRM1 import. Blender 4.2 to 5.2.

item.title: CV Auto Track 1.0.4
item.description: Free Blender add-on (GPL-3.0): OpenCV auto-tracking in the Movie Clip Editor, Fast/Dynamic/High Motion presets, one-click track + solve + refine, filtering of unstable tracks and mask support. 1.0.4 (Oct 12) fixes tracking of parented masks.

item.title: B-Bone Gizmos 1.0.0
item.description: New free Blender extension (GPL-3.0) by Tal Hershko, extracted from AnimToolbox: a Pose mode toolbar tool that shapes bendy bones with Bézier-handle-style gizmos (position, rotation, scale). Blender 4.2 LTS and up.

item.title: Zeeks Hair 1.0.1
item.description: Free Blender add-on (GPL-3.0) that simplifies setting up and tuning soft body dynamics for card, strand or mesh hair. 1.0.1 (October 6) fixes errors and bake bugs. Blender 4.2 LTS and up.

item.title: Blender Animations Plugin 3.1.1 (Roblox)
item.description: Open source Blender add-on (GPL-3.0) for importing and exporting Roblox animations from Blender. 3.1.1 (October 9) fixes easings and a Blender crash. Useful for animating Roblox rigs with Blender’s tools.

item.title: RealMotion Pro 2.0.1
item.description: Paid Blender add-on: a library of ready-to-use animations with retargeting to Auto-Rig Pro, Rigify, Mixamo and Daz. v2 switches to the Extension format; 2.0.1 adds customisable thumbnails and better HumanGen integration. Uninstall versions < 2.0 first.

item.title: cvELD Edit Paint
item.description: Blender add-on ($9.99, paid but GPL) for painting the weights of several bones directly in Edit mode: half brush, directional gradients (including Ribbon), per-vertex weight editor, strict normalisation and protected locks. Blender 4.5 to 5.2.

item.title: Riginsec
item.description: New free Blender add-on (Gumroad, pay what you want) released October 5: it rigs a surface and generates its weights in seconds so you can animate it right away. A very young project, little documented and with no stated licence: test it on a working copy.

item.title: Aseprite 1.3.18.6
item.description: Update of the pixel art and sprite animation editor: crash when pasting tilemaps fixed, sprite sheet JSON export fixed, X11 improvements on Linux. Source code available but non-free licence; paid binaries (compiling it yourself is allowed).

item.title: Blender 5.3 — Grease Pencil: Carver tool and selection in Draw mode
item.description: Blender 5.3 (beta imminent, release planned for Nov 10) beefs up Grease Pencil: lasso/box selection and copy-paste without leaving Draw mode, a Carver tool that cuts strokes and fills as a true boolean, multi-region fill in a single gesture and cyclic strokes.

item.title: Blender 5.3 — Animation & Rigging: rotation mode conversion
item.description: On the animation side, Blender 5.3 finally converts animation natively from one rotation mode to another (Ctrl+R in Pose mode, replacing Rigify’s operator), adds an influence slider to pose pasting, extends Fix to Camera to focal length and pauses playback while scrubbing.

item.title: FreePicker 4.7.0
item.description: Blender add-on (GPL) adding a floating picker to select bones and objects through buttons you place and resize freely, independent of native selection sets, with JSON export/import of layouts. 4.7.0 (Oct 4) adds button duplication. Blender 5.0+.

item.title: OPEN-TOON 0.2.0-experimental
item.description: New open source 2D animation app (GPL, C++/Qt 6) launched Sept 20: vector drawing and MyPaint brushes, timeline/Xsheet, onion skinning, animation curves and an editable character rig. Experimental pre-releases for macOS and Linux (AppImage); a very young project.

item.title: FlowHMR
item.description: Mocap from a single video: FlowHMR (code and weights released late Sept, arXiv paper in Oct) generates physically plausible global 3D body + hand motion, with a web demo and FBX export. Research licence: commercial use prohibited.

item.title: Krita 5.3.4 / 6.0.4
item.description: Krita 5.3.4 (Qt 5) and 6.0.4 (Qt 6, Wayland and HDR on Linux), released Sept 15: the Android version can finally export frame-by-frame animations and timelapses to video, plus a batch of fixes. GIMP XCF import is removed (unmaintained dependency).

item.title: CloudRig 2.2.31
item.description: Blender Studio’s rig generator (free, GPL) reaches 2.2.31 on Oct 5: generation 2 to 5× faster (the gain depends on file complexity, especially with Blender 5.3) and a “Chain: Layered” component polished on the film Cowboi. For Blender 5.0 to 5.x.

item.title: RBF Nodes 4
item.description: Paid add-on ($17.99 on Superhive) by Brave Rabbit: a node-based RBF solver to drive several values from several inputs (shoulder correctives, facial rigs). v4 rebuilds the solver, handles rotations better and adds a free runtime. v3 rigs must be rebuilt.

item.title: LibreSprite 1.3
item.description: Free animated sprite and pixel art editor (GPLv2, Aseprite fork): 1.3 (Oct 2) is the first release since March 2025. Brushes up to 256 px, extended symmetry, tiled mode shortcut, better hi-DPI handling and security fixes (zip-slip, script sandbox).

item.title: FreeMoCap 2.0.0-alpha.25
item.description: Free markerless mocap (AGPL) from webcams: alpha 25 (Sept 24) adds Blender export options in the interface, improves hand detection and fixes use on machines without a GPU. Windows/macOS/Linux installers, but it’s an alpha: be careful.

item.title: Auto-Rig Pro 3.78.62
item.description: Blender’s reference paid rigging add-on keeps updating in late Sept/early Oct: the Smart facial rig detects the face surface and eye shape on its own, new “Auto-Rig Pro Skeleton” Remap preset and more reliable FBX export to Unreal (bind pose).
